name: design-os-figma-plugin
description: Zero-cost live Figma canvas bridge (`figma-agent` CLI + Ease Design Figma Agent plugin) for AI coding agents — works on Figma Free.

interface.shortDescription: Zero-cost live Figma canvas bridge (`figma-agent` CLI + Ease Design Figma Agent plugin) for AI coding agents — works on Figma Free.
interface.longDescription: Inspect live selections, scan design systems, create frames, bind variables, mutate auto-layout traits, and export visual verification PNGs directly from Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the currently selected Figma frame, extract its auto-layout and variable tokens, and build the matching React component.
Scan the active Figma file's design system tokens and create a new 1440x900 pricing section frame using our DLS components.
Update the copy and spacing on the selected hero frame in Figma and export a 2x PNG snapshot to verify visual parity.
